name: walle
description: Walle（瓦力）— 本地 AI 资产管理工具：统一收集、检索、备份各 AI 工具的配置、会话、记忆、Skills、MCP 等资产

scripts.build: npm run build -w @walle/core && npm run build -w @walle/adapters && npm run build -w @walle/cli && npm run build -w @walle/ui
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/gen-fixtures.mjs && node --test test/smoke.test.mjs
